prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a smartwatch on a person’s wrist, displaying an incoming video call. The main focus is the watch screen, which shows a young man with curly hair smiling warmly, his face well-lit and filling most of the frame. The call interface displays the name “Albie” and the word “Connecting…” along with familiar call icons in soft, rounded shapes. The watch itself has a sleek, modern design with a light-colored case and a dark, textured strap. The wearer’s hand and wrist are partially visible, dressed in a casual, dark long-sleeve garment with a hint of red at the cuff. The background is softly blurred, suggesting an outdoor setting with natural daylight, creating a gentle, neutral bokeh effect. The color palette is natural and understated, with warm skin tones, muted blues and grays, and a touch of green from the interface. The overall style is clean and contemporary, with a shallow depth of field that draws attention to the digital interaction and the subject’s cheerful expression, evoking a sense of connection and modern technology in everyday life.
